title: SCO1 error message - limit on emails sent reached
creator: willandjan.parker
content:
I have been receiving the error message quoting the SCO1 policy about reaching my sending limit every day recently. This has happened even when I have only sent 1 or 2 messages and these have only been to a handful of people.

"Sending of the message failed. The message was not sent due to exceeding the allowed number of recipients. The server responded: Policy-SC01 You’ve reached your sending limit. Don’t worry, you can send again soon.."

I have seen a previous strand where this was explained as being something imposed by the email provider not Thunderbird. However I have managed to send emails from the website of my email provider that I haven't been able to send through Thunderbird. This suggests that the previous answer was wrong. I would like to use Thunderbird so please help me sort this out.
